Normattiva's text from 1 January 2027 shows commi 100 to 114 repealed by D.Lgs. 19 June 2026, n. 117, whose Testo unico imposte sui redditi, art. 209, c. 2, carries the same 40,000 and 200,000 euro (read 13.11.2026, library e7d473a7b041c0b6).

tax_on_gain.value: the plan's income from capital and financial gains is not taxed

source.quote: Non sono soggetti a imposizione i redditi di capitale

tax_on_gain.notes: Income from capital other than from qualifying holdings, and the financial gains of art. 67(1)(c-bis) to (c-quinquies) TUIR, of the plan's investments held at least five years (comma 106). The same text is in the Testo unico imposte sui redditi, art. 209, c. 1, from 1 January 2027.

source.title: Legge 11 dicembre 2016, n. 232, art. 1, commi 100-114 (testo in vigore dall'8 agosto 2026)
source.quote: Gli strumenti finanziari in cui è investito il piano devono essere detenuti per almeno cinque anni.

holding_years.notes: The same words are in the Testo unico imposte sui redditi, art. 209, c. 7, from 1 January 2027.

withdraw.value: a sale before five years: the income is taxed by the ordinary rules, with interest and without penalties

source.title: Legge 11 dicembre 2016, n. 232, art. 1, commi 100-114 (testo in vigore dall'8 agosto 2026)
source.quote: sono soggetti a imposizione secondo le regole ordinarie, unitamente agli interessi, senza applicazione di sanzioni

withdraw.notes: Comma 106: on a sale of the plan's instruments before five years, the income realised by the sale and that received during the minimum holding period is taxed by the ordinary rules, together with interest, without penalties; a redemption before five years must be reinvested within ninety days. Testo unico imposte sui redditi, art. 209, c. 7, from 1 January 2027.
